maddeler.e:
أرتضخ (form VIII)
# أَرْتَضِخُ (ʔartaḍiḵu) /ʔar.ta.dˤi.xu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# أُرْتَضَخُ (ʔurtaḍaḵu) /ʔur.ta.dˤa.xu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# أَرْتَضِخَ (ʔartaḍiḵa) /ʔar.ta.dˤi.xa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# أُرْتَضَخَ (ʔurtaḍaḵa) /ʔur.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
